implementation_strategy: Orchestrate confirmatory paired runs using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the openai_responses gpt-5-mini endpoint. Run a Dockerized CPU-only execution environment for deterministic task selection, synthetic-poison generation, verifier/simulator, and logging. For each of the 250 preregistered task_indices: (1) call gpt-5-mini once to produce the shared initial candidate under the baseline/poisoned condition; (2) when validation fails, invoke the guarded generate_validate_repair transformation which may call gpt-5-mini once more (adapter budget = max 2 calls/task). All steps, seeds, and artifacts logged and hashed. No human labour or manual adjudication.
public_resources: Synthetic NetOps task bank (public artifact bundle used to draw tasks; confirmatory partition only; synthetic-poison corpus kept in synthetic-reserved partition)
Open-source verifier/simulator and unit tests (published with execution artifacts)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (openai_responses) — use a single hosted endpoint; model_version = gpt-5-mini
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection via the adapter's challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile (generator offsets [4,5,6,7,8] per 8-task cycle). Task_indices are fixed before any model calls and are recorded in the execution manifest.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-declared transformations only: baseline = direct_configuration_generation_v1; guarded = generate_validate_repair_v1. All transformation code and deterministic poison-insertion scripts are Dockerized and CPU-executable.
execution_batches: 5 sequential batches of 50 tasks each; batches are sequential slices of the preregistered task_indices list (positions 0–49, 50–99, 100–149, 150–199, 200–249). Each batch executes its tasks to completion before proceeding to the next batch to simplify logging and containment checks.
randomisation_plan: No random task selection. Deterministic task_indices per challenging_workflow_stress_v1. Three fixed RNG seeds for transformation/poison generation (preregistered and used reproducibly): [42, 4242, 424242]. Model sampling parameters are recorded but not assumed deterministic.
caching_plan: Cache and deduplicate identical prompt+seed model calls and verifier outputs on a local Docker volume; reuse cached responses to avoid duplicate hosted calls when inputs are identical. All cache keys hashed and recorded.
failure_recovery_plan: Per-call maximum_attempts_per_call=1 (no retry). Any model-call failure or adapter execution error is logged with standardized failure codes. Pairs with any missing condition are excluded from primary analysis per 'complete_pair_primary'. Infrastructure-level restarts are permitted to recover from persistent environment failures and are logged with timestamps and restart reasons.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: JSON record per task_index containing: {task_index:int, condition:string (baseline|guarded), model_call_id:string, model_response:string, actionable_misconfig:0|1 (deterministic automated scorer), verifier_trace:object, transformation_seed:int, call_duration_ms:int, artifact_hash:string}. Each task produces up to two condition records and a paired summary entry used by paired_binary_analysis_v1.
estimated_compute_notes: Total hosted LLM calls = task_count * 2 = 500 (worst-case). All model calls use the gpt-5-mini hosted API. Verifier/simulator runs are CPU-only and Dockerized. Execution fits the capability manifest limits (hosted_model_api_available=true, cpu_execution_available=true, maximum_planned_model_calls=10000, maximum_wall_clock_days=7).
